places.name: Perito Moreno Glacier (UNESCO Site)
places.ai_summary: Iconic, massive glacier in Los Glaciares National Park, famous for its accessibility and frequent calving (ice breaking off). Extensive boardwalks offer stunning, close-up views. Boat trips and ice trekking tours are popular.

opening_hours.notes: Check Los Glaciares NP website for current hours and fees

places.place_tip: Allow plenty of time for the boardwalks. Bring warm, windproof layers regardless of season. Book boat tours or ice trekking well in advance. Located ~1.5 hours drive from El Calafate town.
places.advanced_booking: Required for ice trekking/special tours; recommended for boat trips
places.cost: Paid (National Park entrance fee + optional tours)
places.address: Los Glaciares National Park, Santa Cruz Province, Argentina

places.name: Los Glaciares National Park
places.ai_summary: Vast national park and UNESCO World Heritage site encompassing mountain landscapes, lakes (Argentino, Viedma), and numerous glaciers originating from the Southern Patagonian Ice Field, including Perito Moreno, Upsala, and Spegazzini. Also includes the Fitz Roy range near El Chaltén (northern section).

opening_hours.mon: Park open year-round; specific sectors/trails vary seasonally
opening_hours.notes: Check official website for specific sector hours, fees, trail status, and regulations

places.suggested_duration: Variable (minimum 1 day for Perito Moreno, multiple days for El Chaltén)
places.best_time_to_visit: Nov–Mar (summer) for best weather and access
places.place_tip: Requires separate planning for southern (El Calafate/glaciers) and northern (El Chaltén/hiking) sectors. Entrance fees apply.
places.address: Parque Nacional Los Glaciares, Santa Cruz Province, Argentina

places.name: Glaciarium Museum
places.ai_summary: Modern museum outside El Calafate dedicated to glaciers and Patagonian ice fields. Features informative exhibits, audiovisual displays, and an 'ice bar' (Glaciobar Branca). Good for understanding the region's glaciology.

opening_hours.notes: Hours can vary seasonally, check website; Ice Bar may have separate/later hours

places.place_tip: Located a few km outside town; shuttle buses often run from El Calafate. Ice bar requires separate ticket and provides thermal capes.
places.advanced_booking: Not usually required for museum; recommended for Ice Bar slots
places.cost: Paid (Museum entrance fee; separate fee for Ice Bar)
places.address: Ruta Provincial 11, km 6, Z9405 El Calafate, Santa Cruz, Argentina

places.name: Boat Safari on Lake Argentino
places.ai_summary: General term for various boat tours on Lago Argentino, departing from El Calafate or Puerto Bandera. Options range from short trips near town to full-day excursions visiting multiple glaciers like Upsala and Spegazzini, often navigating among icebergs.

opening_hours.notes: Check specific tour operator schedules

places.place_tip: Full-day glacier cruises ('Todo Glaciares') are popular but long. Shorter options offer lake views and wildlife spotting (flamingos). Bring warm layers.
places.advanced_booking: Recommended, especially for full-day glacier cruises
places.address: Departs from El Calafate or Puerto Bandera, Santa Cruz, Argentina

places.name: Upsala Glacier Cruise
places.ai_summary: Specific type of boat tour on Lago Argentino focusing on the Upsala Glacier, one of the largest in Los Glaciares National Park. Often combined with visits to Spegazzini Glacier and navigating through channels filled with icebergs.

opening_hours.notes: Usually full-day excursions departing from Puerto Bandera

places.place_tip: Upsala glacier face is often viewed from a distance due to iceberg density. Book well in advance. Departs from Puerto Bandera (requires transfer from El Calafate).
places.cost: Paid (Tour cost + Park Fee + Port Tax)
places.address: Departs from Puerto Bandera, Santa Cruz, Argentina

places.name: Estancia Cristina Tour
places.ai_summary: Exclusive full-day tour involving a boat trip across Lago Argentino (often past the Upsala Glacier viewpoint) to a remote historic estancia (ranch). Activities typically include 4x4 excursions to viewpoints, hiking, museum visit, and Patagonian lunch.

opening_hours.notes: Full-day tour, check operator schedule

places.place_tip: Premium, long day trip offering access to remote areas and unique glacier views. Book well in advance. Several tour options (classic, trekking, 4x4).
places.address: Departs from Puerto Bandera, Santa Cruz, Argentina

places.name: Lago Roca Viewpoint
places.ai_summary: Lake within Los Glaciares National Park, south of El Calafate. Offers quieter scenery, camping areas, hiking trails, fishing opportunities, and viewpoints looking towards the southern Andes peaks.

opening_hours.notes: Check park website for specific area access/fees

places.place_tip: Accessible via gravel road (RP 15) from El Calafate. Less crowded alternative to Perito Moreno area for lake and mountain views.
places.advanced_booking: Not required for viewpoint; needed for camping
places.cost: Paid (National Park entrance fee may apply)
places.address: Lago Roca section, Los Glaciares National Park, Santa Cruz, Argentina

places.name: Laguna Nimez Bird Sanctuary
places.ai_summary: Wetland reserve located within walking distance of El Calafate town center, on the shores of Lago Argentino. Excellent for birdwatching, with flamingos, swans, ducks, and various other Patagonian bird species easily spotted from walking trails.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary seasonally; check locally

places.best_time_to_visit: Year-round; early morning or late afternoon often best for bird activity
places.place_tip: Easy walk from town. Bring binoculars if you have them. Can be windy. Follow the marked trails.
places.address: Paseo Costanera Presidente Néstor C. Kirchner, Z9405 El Calafate, Santa Cruz, Argentina

places.name: Calafate Village Market
places.ai_summary: Refers generally to the artisan and souvenir shops concentrated along the main street (Avenida del Libertador) in El Calafate town. Sells local crafts, woollens, chocolates, jams, and Patagonian souvenirs.

opening_hours.notes: Check individual shop hours; may close for siesta

places.place_tip: Good place to buy souvenirs, chocolates, and Calafate berry products. Compare prices.
places.address: Av. del Libertador General San Martín, El Calafate, Santa Cruz, Argentina

places.name_native: Centro Comercial / Paseo de Artesanos El Calafate

places.name: Walichu Caves (Cueva de las Manos)
places.ai_summary: Archaeological site near El Calafate featuring ancient cave paintings (primarily hands and guanaco figures), dating back thousands of years. Located on the shore of Lago Argentino. Offers guided tours explaining the significance.

opening_hours.notes: Check locally or with tour operators for current hours/access

places.place_tip: Accessible via a short drive/taxi from El Calafate. Guided visit is usually mandatory/included in entry. Offers insights into early human presence in Patagonia.
places.advanced_booking: Not usually required, but check for tour times
places.address: Punta Bonita, near El Calafate, Santa Cruz, Argentina

places.name: Mini Trekking on Perito Moreno Glacier
places.ai_summary: Popular guided tour involving a short boat trip to the side of Perito Moreno glacier, followed by donning crampons and walking directly on the ice surface for about 1.5 hours. Offers a unique perspective and experience.

opening_hours.notes: Operated by specific concessionaires (e.g., Hielo y Aventura); check schedule/availability

places.place_tip: Book well in advance. Moderate physical fitness required. Age restrictions apply (usually 10-65 years). Wear sturdy shoes/boots and warm layers.
places.name_english: Mini Trekking On Perito Moreno Glacier
places.address: Departs usually from Bajo Las Sombras pier, Los Glaciares NP, Santa Cruz, Argentina

places.name: Bajo las Sombras Pier
places.ai_summary: Pier ('puerto') located within Los Glaciares National Park, southwest of the main Perito Moreno boardwalks. Serves as the primary departure point for boat navigation close to the glacier's southern face and for Mini Trekking excursions.

opening_hours.notes: Functionally open when tours operate

places.place_tip: Located approx 7km before the main glacier viewpoint parking area. Arrive with time to spare before your tour. Basic facilities (restrooms, small cafe) available.
places.advanced_booking: Required for tours departing from here
places.cost: Access included with tour booking/park fee
places.address: Puerto Bajo Las Sombras, Ruta Provincial 11, Los Glaciares NP, Santa Cruz, Argentina

places.name: El Calafate Regional Museum
places.ai_summary: Small museum in El Calafate town focusing on local history, including indigenous Tehuelche culture, early pioneers, and the development of the town and region. Also known as Centro de Interpretación Histórica.

opening_hours.notes: Hours can vary seasonally, confirm locally

places.place_tip: Provides good historical background for the El Calafate area. Located centrally in town.
places.address: Av. Brown y Bonarelli, Z9405 El Calafate, Santa Cruz, Argentina

places.name: Horseback Riding at Estancias
places.ai_summary: Many estancias (ranches) around El Calafate offer horseback riding excursions ('cabalgatas'). These provide a way to experience the Patagonian landscape, often including views of Lago Argentino or surrounding hills, sometimes combined with traditional meals.

opening_hours.notes: Requires booking with specific estancia or tour operator

places.suggested_duration: Variable (2 hours to Half-day or longer)
places.place_tip: Choose an estancia based on desired scenery and ride duration. Suitable for various experience levels. Wear appropriate clothing (long pants, closed shoes).
places.address: Various Estancias near El Calafate, Santa Cruz, Argentina

places.name: Sunset Viewpoint Peninsula de Magallanes
places.ai_summary: The road (RP 11) leading towards Perito Moreno Glacier runs along the Península de Magallanes. Several informal pull-offs and viewpoints along this route offer excellent sunset views back over Lago Argentino and the surrounding hills.

opening_hours.notes: Public road; park fee applies if within NP boundary

places.place_tip: Find a safe spot to pull over along RP 11 between El Calafate and the glacier entrance. Be prepared for potentially strong winds.
places.cost: Free (roadside); Park fee if inside NP
places.address: Ruta Provincial 11, Península de Magallanes, Santa Cruz, Argentina

places.name: Puerto Bandera Port
places.ai_summary: Port located about 47km west of El Calafate on Lago Argentino. Serves as the primary departure point for full-day glacier cruises, including those visiting Upsala, Spegazzini, and Estancia Cristina.

opening_hours.notes: Must arrive before scheduled boat departure time; check tour operator instructions

places.place_tip: Requires transfer (bus/taxi/car) from El Calafate. Arrive with ample time for check-in. Port tax usually payable here in cash. Basic facilities available.
places.advanced_booking: Required for tours departing from here
places.cost: Access included with tour booking/park fee; port tax required
places.address: Puerto Bandera, Ruta Provincial 11, Los Glaciares NP, Santa Cruz, Argentina

places.name: Lago Argentino Kayak Tour
places.ai_summary: Guided kayaking excursions on Lago Argentino, offering a different perspective on the lake, potential iceberg views (depending on location/conditions), and Patagonian scenery from water level.

opening_hours.notes: Weather dependent; check operator schedules

places.place_tip: Several operators offer tours from different locations. Choose based on desired scenery and duration. Drysuits usually provided for warmth.
places.address: Various departure points near El Calafate, Santa Cruz, Argentina

places.name: Bahía Redonda Walkway
places.ai_summary: Paved walkway along the shore of Bahía Redonda, a bay of Lago Argentino adjacent to El Calafate town. Offers pleasant strolls with views of the lake, birdlife (including flamingos at Laguna Nimez nearby), and surrounding hills.

opening_hours.notes: Public walkway

places.place_tip: Easy walk accessible from town center. Good for stretching legs or enjoying lake views, especially at sunrise or sunset. Connects near Laguna Nimez.
places.address: Paseo Costanera Presidente Néstor C. Kirchner, El Calafate, Santa Cruz, Argentina

places.name: Patagonian Lamb Dinner at Mi Rancho
places.ai_summary: Experiencing 'Cordero Patagónico' (Patagonian Lamb), often slow-roasted 'al asador' (on a cross over embers), is a culinary highlight. Mi Rancho is one of several well-known restaurants ('parrillas') in El Calafate specializing in this.

opening_hours.notes: Check specific restaurant hours; reservations often needed

places.place_tip: Reservations highly recommended, especially in peak season. Other popular parrillas include La Tablita, Don Pichon.
places.name_english: Patagonian Lamb Dinner At Mi Rancho (or similar)
places.address: Gobernador Moyano 986, Z9405 El Calafate, Santa Cruz, Argentina (Mi Rancho example)

places.name: El Calafate Artisan Market
places.ai_summary: Covered market area in El Calafate town (Paseo de Artesanos) where local artisans sell crafts, souvenirs, textiles, pottery, woodwork, and other handmade goods.

opening_hours.notes: Hours can vary by season and vendor

places.place_tip: Good place to find locally made souvenirs. Located near the main street.
places.address: Paseo de Artesanos, Av. del Libertador General San Martín, El Calafate, Santa Cruz, Argentina
